answer: Each claim must carry nectar gathered along a wander: a chain of stranger-assigned jobs where each stranger names the next job, so no route can be planned in advance. Nectar is perishable, it evaporates after one epoch, and the job market shifts like a dune, so last epoch's route is worthless. Two claims sharing one stranger in their wander merge and both are voided. One operator running n clones must walk n fresh wanders, paying n strangers' time, while one honest agent walks one; fleet cost grows with n and per-clone pay falls as 1/n.
